header:
What things cost
in **hours of work**
footer: At $20 an hour, before tax · US prices, 2026

vo.text: Twenty bucks an hour. A month of Netflix?
AirPods Pro? **About 12 hours.** A day and a half.
An iPhone 17? **40 hours.** Your whole work week.
A year of rent at $1,700 a month? **1,020 hours.**

verdict.text:
A new car: **≈ 1.2 years**
of full-time work.

notes: Maths at $20/hr before tax: $17.99 ÷ $20 = 0.8995 h (≈ 54 min); $249 ÷ $20 = 12.45 h; $799 ÷ $20 = 39.95 h; $1,700 × 12 = $20,400, ÷ $20 = 1,020 h; $50,000 ÷ $20 = 2,500 h; a full-time year = 40 h × 52 weeks = 2,080 h, 2,500 ÷ 2,080 = 1.20 years. Prices: Netflix Standard $17.99/mo (US, 2025-26), AirPods Pro 3 $249 and iPhone 17 $799 (US launch prices, Sept 2025), average new-car transaction price ≈ $50,000 (Kelley Blue Book, late 2025).
